need: Hazard: the cap-crossing row in a non-Latin script, where the character-versus-byte arithmetic is at its widest. This article extracts to 121 106 characters, almost every one of them a Han ideograph costing three UTF-8 bytes, so the file is roughly 340 000 bytes. The 40 000-character index cap therefore admits about a third of the characters and about a ninth of what a byte-counted cap of the same nominal size would admit. The free-content attribution in 資料來源, at character 73 736, is on the far side of it — and it is the one statement on the page that a licence audit has to find.

expected_miss_mechanism: index_fulltext_max_chars: the 資料來源 free-content attribution lies at character 73 736 of a 121 106-character extraction, past the 40 000-character cap; the cap counts characters, and this page's Han ideographs are three UTF-8 bytes each, so the indexed prefix is about a third of the characters and about 120 000 of some 340 000 bytes
